item.title: The honor system for superintelligence
item.description: Six AI giants signed a voluntary White House accord to audit themselves — hired auditors, board committees, no definition of 'robust,' no deadlines — while Washington renamed AI 'Super Intelligence' before defining it.

item.title: The IPO of the apocalypse
item.description: Anthropic's IPO prospectus warns its own AI could pose an existential risk to humanity — 80 pages of risk factors, 48 pages of business — and asks investors to price it at $2 trillion.

item.title: Nvidia will sell you the brakes too
item.description: On Nvidia's Open Agent Safety Platform, the two companies missing from the launch roster, and the $150 billion buyback announced in the same breath.

item.title: The little guy beat Apple for $5.7 billion — with a hedge fund’s money
item.description: On the record $5.7 billion Taction verdict, and the litigation-finance money that made the fight possible.

item.title: The agents aren’t rogue. They’re just unsupervised.
item.description: On OpenAI’s rogue-agent summer, CAPTCHA-solving bots, and why the scariest part isn’t the escape.
